coverage_notes.assessment: No source-verified, nonduplicate high-value food-access disruption newly reported in the estimated hourly observation window after twelve targeted searches and eight direct-source checks.
coverage_notes.limitations: Search engine yielded many stale results despite recency filters. This is not exhaustive real-time nationwide coverage; local provider updates and social notices may not be indexed promptly. Direct website pages often lack update timestamps. Exact immediately prior heartbeat could not be enumerated through available repository browsing, so the window start uses the recorded prior task execution time; production collector and its deduplication queue were not checked.
coverage_notes.action_limits: Append exactly one JSON heartbeat to ops/watch-ledger; no approval, publication, task disabling, schedule changes, or production modifications.
